reviews.text: The entire staff was incredibly kind in welcoming my lethargic and unwell 15-year-old cat in the middle of the night. Even when the vet strongly suggested keeping him on an IV drip for the rest of the night, I didn't feel pressured or judged when I preferred to keep him home and bring him back a few hours later for the ultrasound. I felt confident leaving my cat with them all day for the ultrasound, and I wasn't worried they would give him less attention simply because he's older. (I was lucky to get good news from the ultrasound, and my cat is doing a bit better.) Yes, the services were expensive, but I think that unfortunately reflects the clinic's actual costs. (I paid approximately: ~$250 for the consultation, ~$400 for the blood test, ~$800 for the ultrasound, and ~$200 for the prescriptions.) I have nothing but respect for the team and the hard work they do.

UPDATE 2026: I've revised my rating from 1 star to 4 stars.

After two consultations at this clinic, one for Gaia (dog) and the other for Gertrude (cat), I must say that the entire team was incredibly kind and competent.

Gaia was seen quickly due to respiratory distress. She was already receiving palliative care. Sadly, it was her last day. The veterinarian who handled the situation was incredibly kind and understanding!

We received honest service and were able to make informed decisions while fully aware of the situation. It was a devastating time for us, but the support of the staff and the gentle way in which Gaia passed away ultimately contributed to a more positive experience.

Gertrude went for an emergency consultation and was very well received and treated. Once again, the team was very available to answer questions, and the veterinarian was, once again, very honest in outlining the treatment plan.

2024-2025
It's perfect for buying food. They're open all the time (until 11 p.m.). But keep in mind that it's a bit more expensive than elsewhere.

The new staff members are undertrained. Today I went, and the girl with pink hair greeted me without even looking at me; she kept staring at her computer. I placed my order, and she made a mistake. I repeated what I'd said (my order), and she looked at me as if to say, "What are you talking about?" Again, the girl was very unpleasant... so I told her, "Yes, the ID low-fat pâté I ordered." She looked like a deer in front of a truck on the highway. I told her that she did indeed seem absorbed in her computer and that this was probably why she couldn't process the order.

She replied abruptly that she had to enter my order into the computer. I paid, said have a good day, and she didn't respond. She turned away and went about her business. Haha! Ungrateful.

The other day I went there and bought Flexadin Advanced for my dog. This product is part of a loyalty program. The cashier had no idea about it, where the loyalty card was (I had used up my previous one), she had to open a file in my name to make a note saying that next time, they would have to give me the card...

Terrible customer service. The girl with the pink hair... Ungrateful, rude, and unprofessional attitude. I will now shop elsewhere.
Thank you for your availability and kindness. You are truly reassuring and very gentle with our Elton. Your care is excellent.

Thank you for the impeccable service, staff was very helpful, respectful and considerate.
Prices where reasonable for the emergency services. Do recommend.

From the emergency room visit to the life-saving surgery for my little cat (sarcoma and amputation), only two weeks passed. I highly recommend them. Be sure to ask for estimates, as some tests and surgeries can be quite expensive.

We booked an appointment with Dr. Camille St-Jean in internal medicine and we loved our experience.

It was our first visit to the Montreal Veterinary Centre, but not our first experience with internal medicine, and I recommend this centre 100%.
We were greeted with great empathy and received clear and detailed explanations. You can tell that Dr. Camille St-Jean isn't motivated by money and doesn't encourage you to pay unnecessarily for tests that aren't needed.
I am truly very happy and grateful for our experience. Thank you!
The service was excellent with a compassionate staff

Absolute veterinary emergency Saturday night. Very grim prognosis, no unnecessary tests other than the most relevant one (abdominal ultrasound). What professionalism from this team, from reception to the veterinary technician and the veterinarian whose intervention remained directly focused on the issues at hand. What compassion in the final moments with my cat, my last act of love. You are truly a wonderful team, and it reassures me that such an emergency clinic exists in Montreal!

A nighttime visit for my little dog, exceptional service with a professional team, we are truly very satisfied.
Thank you again.
Michael and Prince 👑 …

We are very grateful for the care and attention our cat has received. The entire team has consistently shown professionalism, kindness, and genuine dedication. Your thorough approach to diagnoses and treatments gives us great confidence and peace of mind. Every visit takes place in a reassuring environment where we truly feel that everything possible is being done for our pet's well-being. Thank you to the entire team for your exceptional care and commitment.
Quick response and excellent service
Expensive but reliable service and friendly bilingual vets. Second time bringing my cat here for an emergency, both times I had a good experience.
24 hours a day is very convenient. Especially for emergency. They will try and upsell you tho. Lovely front desk staff on the night of my visit.
Courteous, attentive, and available staff. Prompt service. Clean premises. Parking available.
High-quality service, respectful of both the animal and the owner. Attentive and compassionate too.

The veterinarian, Dr. S. Cardellini, was attentive, kind, professional, offered several options, took into account the owner's needs and requirements, took the time to explain, and was efficient! In short, I would recommend her for any emergency.
Excellent service. Staff was extremely compassionate and I felt at ease. They explained everything to me in a caring manner. I felt my beautiful boy Phoenix was in loving hands.. Thank you ❤️
Sadly my cat got unexpectedly sick and passed away but the team was very helpful and able to do a number of tests quickly onsite. All the help and support was greatly appreciated.
Emergency consultations work well

A huge thank you to the entire team for your kindness, compassion, and support during my cat's final moments. She was a fighter until the very end and was able to pass away peacefully, surrounded by so much love. Thank you from the bottom of my heart.
Kindness, a smile, attentiveness, exemplary service
Excellent emergency hospital. The staff is very professional and courteous. My babies are always well cared for! THANK YOU!!!

Terrible customer service. I've tried contacting them by email six times to request a form to fill out, and I haven't received a reply.

Seriously, the worst service I've ever experienced, and for an outrageous price.
Fast service, clear and precise explanations regarding upcoming procedures, very friendly staff.
Attentive and very empathetic staff.

if you love your pets and you care about them , please don’t take them to this clinic 🙏🏻 they just care about money and they take more than they deserve, I took my cat and during his consultation he lost his tooth because the pressure touched in his mouth and the veterinarian didn’t even put oxygen water on his mouth, she was opening his mouth until he lost his tooth and she still said i didn’t see his mouth well and if I didn’t ask her for an antalgique for his pain she wouldn’t give me anything , i regret to go there and lost 400$ for nothing , my cat got traumatized and she gave me no     prescription , literally I just lost money for nothing.
A fantastic team who truly care about our furry friends. Thank you for your work, a place to support 200%! ❤️

Our cat was hospitalized in intensive care for 10 days at the Montreal Veterinary Centre. Despite all the stress and anxiety this situation caused us, we are extremely satisfied with the services provided by the entire team, from reception to intensive care. The team demonstrated genuine empathy and exceptional professionalism. The various professionals were always transparent with us regarding the costs and care provided to our cat.

Your pet will be well cared for by the team at the Montreal Veterinary Centre.
They took excellent care of my cat.   It had a UTI.   Urgent care was such a blessing.  They kept the cost low and gave great instructions.   I could not recommend this emergency vet more.

Amazing staff, we came on a busy day for an emergency. The staff managed to take care of my dog's wound in his paw and he is now recovering well. I thank everyone from this centre who were present on a sunday before labors day. You are great people.

This was our second visit in six years for emergency care for our dog. Each time, the reception and services were courteous, efficient, and reassuring. A professional, friendly, and empathetic team. We would gladly adopt the clinic full-time if we lived closer.

I wanted to sincerely thank the team for their thoughtful gesture, which touched me deeply.

After the sudden passing of my cat, Gus, I received a call informing me that I could come and collect his collar. It took me a few days to muster the courage to go, and I was given a small paper bag that I didn't open right away, assuming it simply contained his collar.

A few months later, I finally opened it and discovered a handwritten sympathy card, prints of his tiny paws and nose, and a few pieces of his fur.

I truly wasn't expecting this and was incredibly moved. I had declined ashes and other mementos at the time of his death, so they were under no obligation to do this. It was simply a profoundly human and compassionate gesture.

Thank you for taking care of my Gus and my brother and for leaving me with such a precious memory of him. ❤️
This isn't the first time.
The staff were very respectful and attentive.
best and most compassionate staff! truly could not have asked for better! so reassuring and made everything feel smooth
Uneducated staff .
A thousand thanks! Quick response, courteous service and excellent care provided with transparency.

Wonderful emergency care vet. The receptionists- warm and welcoming--- and the veterniary tech and vet- both very efficient, knowledgable, kind and experienced - inspired confidence at such a stressful time. And thanks to this team, our cat is getting well!

They desperately need more vets and vet techs. This is an emergency clinic, and it took us 4 hours to see a vet. For the high prices they charge, this level of delay and disorganization is unacceptable when pets need urgent care.

Unqualified and tries to upsell you. Basically they make money by suggesting you check in your pet to their hospital facility without it being really necessary. It’s 3000 dollars for a few days. Absurd practice and way higher pricing structure than regular clinics. Unethical to the core.
Very friendly, respectful and professional staff.
Impeccable service and care. Thank you to the entire team for taking care of Sirius and supporting us through this difficult time.

Thank you for saving my cat.

Perry was hospitalized for two days after eating half a cup of raisins. Yes, dried raisins. They were attentive, caring, and always kept me in the loop. I was able to visit him during his stay and he appeared happy and well cared for. Their quote for the cost was accurate and extremely reasonable. He received round the clock care.

I came from ontario. Thank you

After several visits to different clinics, another emergency brought me to this clinic on a Sunday evening. I was received with great empathy and kindness; the veterinarian took the time to explain everything in detail so I could make the right decision, without imposing anything that would unnecessarily increase the bill. I highly recommend them! A big thank you!
Excellent service, appropriate care for the animal's condition, welcoming, warm, and attentive staff, both to the animal and its owners. Thank you.

It is with great sadness my dog was euthanized here after battling idiopathic epilepsy. It took me a while to write this review, but I needed time to digest and heal. The staff was incredibly kind through a traumatic, hard process and their kindness and patience was felt through the whole experience.

Despite the stressful situations that brought us to this clinic, the staff has always been professional, courteous, attentive, and above all, empathetic. We always felt well cared for and were given good information to make informed decisions. We unfortunately had to say goodbye to our cat, Belle, on Wednesday evening, but we couldn't have asked for better support.
To the entire team, from the receptionists to the veterinarians, technicians, and all the other staff members we don't always see, THANK YOU!

I dropped off my dog ​​in an emergency, they charged me $2200, I went back to pick him up, and his beautiful long leather leash, which had belonged to my other dogs, was gone... they gave it to someone else. It's been 10 days of follow-ups and they're ignoring me, no note in my file, no follow-up... what a lack of professionalism and ethics... how can we trust them with our animals????
I arrived with my dog ​​who was almost dead, thanks to the staff, they were very quick and very kind, and my baby is already playing 🙏🏼❤️ …

Emergency services Sunday night. The reception, the service, everything was amazing, even though they were overwhelmed. You really have a fantastic team. Thank you from the bottom of our hearts, we felt listened to and reassured. From Ma'iingan's family.
Excellent service. Our pet received immediate care. The staff were attentive and clear about the diagnostic and therapeutic options. A valuable resource when faced with an emergency.
Excellent service and not much of a wait; I recommend them for your pets when it's urgent or if you don't have a vet.

Very helpful, friendly and professional staff.
The diagnosis and treatment plan given soothed my worries.
In fact, the next day my cat was much improved, 2 days later she was her old self again.

I would like to thank the receptionist who was there Sunday evening. His professionalism, calm demeanor, and attentiveness were remarkable. He convinced me to stay despite the short wait, even though I wanted to leave because of my baby's crying. He reassured me and found us a room.

Agathe was treated quickly, and in hindsight, staying was definitely the right decision.

Thank you for your invaluable service!

I highly recommend this clinic. We needed to go there for an emergency and had very little waiting time (lucky us, as the number of patients can vary greatly, especially in the evenings and on weekends). The staff is very friendly and attentive. We were informed of the costs upfront, so there were no surprises upon arrival. Everything was explained very clearly by the veterinarian and the technicians.

Treating our cat is difficult because she becomes very aggressive with vets.

There's also a parking option, which can be very convenient.
All the staff are very kind, friendly, and respectful. The veterinarians are patient and attentive to our concerns about our animals' health. It's a bit pricey, but it's worth it in an emergency.

The team quickly took care of my cat Titan and were extremely kind, caring, and professional. While I sincerely hope I never need their services for my cats again, I would return to this emergency clinic without hesitation.
They immediately took charge of my cat, felt like I was in good hands. Everyone was really nice. Xox

On Sunday, July 26, 2026, around 4 or 5 a.m., in the middle of the night, the emergency veterinarians at the VET et NOUS veterinary emergency clinic, located near the Papineau metro station in Montreal, were able to stabilize our dog, Tapie (a big, fluffy, all-white Samoyed), and then we were able to take him to Longueuil, as they had referred us, for surgery to correct his gastric torsion. No complaints whatsoever. The veterinarians did a truly excellent job. However, at 7 a.m., when we tried to go home, we realized we had lost our house keys (a set with an orange climbing carabiner and multiple accessories, including a red pendant). We called Longueuil, but they weren't there. We called the emergency veterinary clinic near Papineau station again. The receptionist checked, put us on hold, and the call quickly disconnected. I called her back, and she said she couldn't find the keys. Since the call had just disconnected, I made sure to describe in detail all the steep and hidden places where my keys could have fallen and where I had been walking around—sitting in the reception area, standing in the private cubicle, leaning up against the handler. I reiterate that I was very stressed at their clinic and that we were constantly pacing and moving around the entire time we were there (we spent a sleepless night), and that we could possibly have dropped our keys at the reception desks while trying to grab something. We were thinking we'd put our keys in the cup bin, on the left, to shorten our dog's leash, or even near the cup bin next to the water fountain because we were close and had just given the dog water. The receptionist at Papineau finally got angry and told me indirectly that "if I don't trust the way she tried to find our keys, we're free to come back and check for ourselves!" That's quite a response, honestly! It's just unacceptable to be spoken to like that, really. She continued talking over us while I tried to explain that if our house keys had fallen into the cup bin and the trash had been emptied in the meantime, coming back would be pointless! The tone escalated, and she continued talking over me. We had just paid them over $1000 in the middle of the night; we come regularly for emergencies for all our animals. We didn't sleep a wink. was in tears, we never hesitated to pay the amounts without complaint, even when the amounts were very high (I've lost count of the thousands of dollars left at this emergency clinic) and in the end we don't know if our dog will survive, we are desperate: in one night and in the space of a few hours we had to pay $11,000. I found the receptionist's reaction condescending towards us and inappropriate given the situation we were experiencing and our regular loyalty to this emergency clinic. I am simply shocked!
Excellent service for an emergency after 11 pm. The staff were welcoming and professional. I will keep their contact information and highly recommend the clinic.

Exceptional and empathetic service! From the moment we arrived, the reception was impeccable: quick, reassuring, and professional, which makes all the difference during a stressful time.

A special thank you to Dr. Florence Audet Robin and Dr. Rafael Tremblay. They are exceptional veterinarians, very attentive and clearly passionate about their work. Their positive energy and gentle interactions with our dog, Zelda, touched us deeply. They took the time to reassure us while providing top-quality care. A dedicated and caring team that I recommend without hesitation. A big thank you to the entire team!

A huge thank you to the entire team at the Montreal Veterinary Centre and its emergency department. We brought our cat Shiva in when she was very lethargic, feverish, and had stopped eating. She was seen quickly, hospitalized, and examined with great care. The explanations were clear, the follow-up attentive, and the return instructions very thorough.

Of course, as others have pointed out, emergency care is expensive, but given the seriousness of the situation and the professionalism of the team, it was well worth the cost. Today, Shiva has regained her normal behavior, energy, and enormous appetite. We are convinced that their speed and professionalism likely saved her life.

Thank you sincerely to the entire team!

We are extremely grateful to have had access to this 24/7 emergency clinic. Knowing we could count on a team available at any time brought us immense comfort during a very distressing situation.

Our dog suffered a serious leg injury and was bleeding heavily. On the way to the clinic, the police had blocked the street due to fireworks, and we couldn't get through on De Maisonneuve. We were stuck in traffic while our dog needed immediate care. We eventually had to get out of the car and walk to the clinic carrying him so he could be treated as quickly as possible.

We want to emphasize that this situation was in no way the fault of the clinic or its staff, but rather a circumstance beyond their control.

As soon as the receptionist saw me come in with my dog ​​in my arms, covered in blood, both on me and on the towel I was using to try and control the bleeding, she immediately understood the urgency of the situation and reacted with great speed and compassion. Her professionalism and calm demeanor greatly helped make this extremely stressful moment easier to manage.

The entire team provided us with exceptional service, demonstrating great dedication and kindness. We are sincerely grateful for the care they gave our dog when we needed it most.

Our only wish is that a 24/7 emergency clinic would also be available closer to East Montreal, as there are currently no clinics open around the clock in that area. Such a local service would be a tremendous help to pet owners facing emergency situations.
Highly competent and responsive team.

We had a wonderful experience at the Montreal Veterinary Centre. Our miniature dachshund, Oscar, became very ill quickly, and they took excellent care of him. He came home the following evening after being hospitalized. The staff were very patient and kind to us. We returned the next morning, and they listened to our concerns and reassured us that Oscar was doing well. I highly recommend them if your pet needs emergency care. Thank you to the whole team! 💕
Everything is perfect, the service is impeccable. They've thought of everything, even coffee and water are available.

Thank you to Dr. Deschênes and her entire team for your attentiveness and kindness. Arriving late in the evening in an emergency with my cat, I received a professional and courteous welcome, and he was seen promptly. Unfortunately, after the consultation, I had to make the difficult decision to let him go. Thank you for giving him a peaceful passing.

I had a great experience with this veterinary clinic. The veterinarians were kind, professional, and took the time to answer all my questions. They explained everything clearly and made me feel much more at ease about my cat's condition. I truly appreciate their care and compassion. Thank you for helping us—I highly recommend this clinic!

I hate going there, but they give amazing care. Our dog loves their staff so much he takes us once a year.

Very knowledgeable staff. They thoroughly explain everything and give you as many options as they can for treating your pet. They are very up front with the costs and we have never been surprised by our bill.
Very friendly staff, knowledgeable vet, she explained the different options in a way that I could understand! Recommended
The emergency situation was handled very well and everything was explained to me clearly. Chanel was quickly taken to safety, thank you.
Efficient, professional and competent. Very satisfied!
The staff is professional and friendly.

I haven’t gone in yet (hopefully I don’t need too) but my cat ate half a string, one of those fuzzy worm toys. When I called she gave me 3 options right away with transparent pricing along with informing me about current road blockages. She was very reassuring when I was panicking! Thank you for the advice <3
The "Cadillac" of services!! The perfect combination of expertise and interpersonal skills!! 🙏🙏🙏 …
Fast, attentive, and efficient service. Thank you very much.
Excellent, professional, and friendly service ❤️
Great experience, very quick and they really took the time with my dog.

ORIGINAL POSTING 6 YEARS AGO: My dog ​​was dying, and I was less than $100 short of the care he needed to live. I promised to pay first thing the next morning because I was getting paid, but the services were refused despite my long-standing clientele and prompt payments throughout the nearly 13 years my dog ​​had been with us. I was forced to spend the worst night of my life watching my dog ​​die at home because he couldn't breathe, all for less than $100. I returned the next morning (because I had received my paycheck) to euthanize my poor dog who couldn't breathe. It's the most traumatic experience I've ever had! Watching my dog ​​die peacefully because he couldn't breathe, and the clinic management refusing to help me unless I paid the entire bill upfront. Maybe he would still be alive if I'd just had an extra $100 the night before, or even better, if the management of this clinic had a little compassion and trust in their long-time clients. But anyway, I now have a new dog that I will never let be treated at this clinic. As the saying goes, you only know who your true friends are when you're going through a rough patch. This clinic is no friend to anyone, only interested in money thanks to the management (it's all about the cash). Please, if you truly love your animals, avoid this heartless and uncomprehending clinic. Worst customer experience of my life, period!

FOLLOW-UP 2026-07-03: The management of this clinic has not been able to provide any response or comment in 6 years. That speaks volumes about the administration. I hope, for the well-being of the animals, that there have been improvements.
The staff are very welcoming and professional. They take the time to explain everything respectfully and kindly.

This emergency vet clinic is absolutely magnificent. We recently adopted a cat who had just had both of her eyes removed, and needed after care that our regular vet could not provide. The staff here were attentive, kind and understanding. I wouldn’t hesitate to return if I ever had an abnormal circumstance.
Excellent service. Everything is well explained and choices are offered without making you feel guilty.

I brought my dog here last night in an emergency, shivering, panting, and had just been bleeding from her behind. Despite calling ahead to alert them, the receptionist was incredibly dry, slow, and insisted on a lengthy check in performance. Making a panicked pet owner spell out their full name, address, email, and sign AI consent forms while holding a bleeding animal is completely unacceptable. This paperwork or payment protocol should be handled online or after my dog is triaged.
While the medical staff was lovely once we finally saw them, the front desk bottleneck is dangerous for emergent cases. The reception team severely needs sensitivity training for emergencies. I will not return.

We went to have a cat euthanized. All the staff, from reception to technician and veterinarian, were very kind and empathetic. The service was quick and respectful.
Thank you from the bottom of our hearts to the whole team!
A welcoming place upon arrival. Good listening skills. Short wait. Enthusiastic and reassuring veterinarian. The trip was worth it.
Excellent service! The price was reasonable, reflecting the emergency situation and opening hours! An essential service for all of East Montreal!

Huge thank you to dr Tremblay and all the staff during our visit. It was emotional and stressful but the staff was incredibly kind and patient and very helpful. Seems a lot of people come here for emergencies as they’re open 24/7. I appreciated so much that they followed up for an update on our dogs condition the following day. The staff are all clearly animal lovers, I really felt we were in good hands. I would recommend anyone come here if they have a crisis or need urgent vet attention
I felt completely confident at all times and knew my cat was in good hands. The reception, the consultation, and the treatment were all remarkably effective. Thank you so much.

I took my dog, Minnie, to Centre Vétérinaire the other day after she got sick suddenly and seemed to be deteriorating. The staff were so patient and understanding from the moment I arrived and were very thorough on intake. I do speak French but English is my first language. Trying to explain all of her symptoms was difficult, but they were very accommodating and spoke English with me. I wasn't sure who checked me in, but she was very kind and patient, along with Rachel the vet tech. Dr. Joëlle Lemieux was equally amazing and knowledgeable, and I am so grateful to her for being so compassionate towards Minnie and me. When she was explaining the procedures and best steps to take, she was also very transparent with the prices and never pushed me to make any decisions I was not comfortable with. When I got news that was not so good, she was also incredibly gentle and understanding. They performed a small procedure on my dog and made sure I was aware of everything they were doing. The follow up has also been greatly appreciated. Since I don't live in Montreal, it was quite daunting taking Minnie somewhere new, but I highly recommend this animal hospital to anyone who needs emergency care for their furry friend. Thank you from the bottom of my heart for taking such good care of her and for advocating for her, I am truly grateful!

A very typical emergency call at night; they gave the cat methadone without our consent. She told us the cat's condition was stable and we could go home. The cat died with severe convulsions three minutes after we arrived home. Truly heartbreaking.
Relief, comfort, and guidance for the rest of the treatment. My deepest gratitude.
Excellent clinic! Thank you for your great service.

Words cannot describe how greatly I appreciate the care my beautiful boi has had here. We rushed Pablo in and he was seen to immediately. Since then we have been updated consistently and had such kind interactions with everyone
Thank you so much. We have a little more time with him and that is only due to the care you have given him
him. I will never forget the kindness you have shown our family.
Listen!! Be present!! Thank you so much!!!

I received excellent service for my cat!
All the staff were extremely kind, and they even emailed me to check on Moka and see if she was doing better :)

24 hour vet service. We thought after we brought our pup in they would put on a bandage.
It's expensive but it's an emergency clinic.
Fast and attentive emergency veterinary service, and all the staff are very kind.
A clinic that offers professional and compassionate service. Warm welcome, competent staff, and a very reasonable wait time. I recommend the clinic without hesitation.

I came because my cat had lost weight over the past few days. Sadly, he had childhood leukemia at just 2.5 years old, and was euthanized immediately. The staff before the vet were very professional, and the vet herself was very frank and professional. They gave me all the time I needed, and I even received a little note with my cat's paw prints. So, thank you!

I received completely professional and empathetic service when I arrived with my 13-year-old dog who was having seizures. I received clear explanations and constant updates on his condition during his hospitalization. Unfortunately, I had to have my beloved dog euthanized 36 hours later, but all the staff were very respectful and empathetic. Two weeks later, I received a card with words of encouragement, along with a print of my dog's nose and one of his paws, as well as a small tuft of his fur. This touched me deeply, and I want to thank them from the bottom of my heart for everything they did for my beloved dog, Buddy.
We went at night and the service was excellent.

We went for an emergency at 1am with our 21yo cat and they took us right away they were very kind the staff was flawless service nothing bad to say ! They gave us time to say good bye to our cat chanelle and were not pushy about it thanks a lot !

I went to this veterinary clinic on a Saturday afternoon, without an appointment, for an emergency with my Maltese. The staff was very friendly, the wait time was very reasonable, and both the veterinary technician and the doctor were very professional and competent. Furthermore, if the treatment isn't working well or if my pet's health deteriorates and I need to come back within 48 hours, they told me I wouldn't have to pay for the second consultation! I think that's excellent service!
A very attentive and caring team, competent and they explain things well

Excellent experience, reasonable prices for an emergency service. Professional, welcoming, attentive, and knowledgeable. No unpleasant surprises with additional charges; everything was clearly explained, and the care was excellent, with reassurance regarding my health.
Excellent service!
We really appreciate this great review. Thank you!

It was a very good experience…the waiting time was not too long. The vet, his assistant and the receptionist were extremely helpful and very knowledgeable and very friendly…Anytime I have an issue with my pets i will definitely go back. I highly recommend this emergency vet hospital.
The staff is fantastic. We went there for an emergency with my dog. Super fast service, lovely vet! Thank you so much!

I went there in an emergency with my cat.
The staff were welcoming and competent.
I will definitely go back if needed.
I recommend it!
Thank you for taking the time to rate your visit. It is greatly appreciated.
Thank you for taking the time to share your experience with us.

These guys are great with my dog. They always take into account his history and any concerns I might have. They are expensive, they are an emergency vet. But they genuinely care about all the animals that are brought to them, present plans and costs clearly, and send files to your regular vet.
Excellent service. I came twice with my cat and the staff were friendly, qualified and very attentive.
Professional, quality care, warm welcome
My cat was so calm, he's usually quite anxious at the vet. I also appreciated what was prioritized in terms of treatment.

On March 24th, 2026, I experienced the worst day of my adult life.
My beloved cat, Nori, was diabetic and diagnosed in November. I was treating him and although it was hard to get his glycemia perfectly under Controlz he was more energetic, decent levels, gaining weight, and the vet told me that things seemed okay and to try different food if anhthing.

On March 24th Nori stopped eating. I took him to the emergency vet.
They told me he wasnt responding to the insulin and my best option was euthanasia.

I have to preface this by saying that I dont remember a large majority of this because I was clocked out mentally. My partner told me I was banging my head against the wall, I was waiting and crying, I was screaming, and beyond consoling.
I am ve4y embarrassed by my behaviour but I was in shock

The vet treating Nori (i wish I knew her name to thank her) was patient and kind and empathetic. She didnt rush me. She let me hold Nori and was very understanding.

Thank you for being compassionate on this horrible day
They are wonderful, attentive, and explain the treatment plan very well. My dog ​​is doing much better thanks to them. I am very grateful and highly recommend them!

We went in urgently to say goodbye to our old cat Rastapopoulos. From beginning to end, we received excellent service. The staff were truly empathetic and professional 🤍 They gave us the straight facts, and we were able to say goodbye in a peaceful environment.

Thank you Florian and the staff 🤍🐾
Very fast and courteous service; my cat was seen immediately and we left in under 1.5 hours with all the necessary treatment, clearly explained. Thank you to the team!

When you have a dog so sick that it needs a specialist, it's hard to deal with this kind of reception when calling the CVMTL. Thank goodness Dr. Saint-Jean is wonderful.
